messages:
sasha: FYI canary validator flip to strict (v2.1) is causing an uptick in fncall rejects -> degen routing. Customers saw fallbacks to smaller models. Root reason looks like `missing_field` and `invalid_type`.

nina: Oh no. Do we have examples for the dashboard? I couldn't find sampled payloads in recent logs. :thinking_face:

kevin: We turned sampling off for nonfatal rejects to reduce noise last week (sampling=0). That broke observability. My bad.

michael: For console rollouts we need finer gradation than on/off. Proposal: toggle states = [permissive, soft-validate (log+sample), strict]. Soft-validate should surface 1% sanitized examples and a "force-strict" for specific routes.

sasha: +1. Also add a metric `fncall.validator.action{route,from,to}` with values coerce|reject|accept.

kevin: Suggest adding a lightweight coercion pass before hard reject: coerce nullables, try JSON object->array fixes, then re-run schema. Emit `validator.action=coerce` when successful. Will mark in telemetry. Code stub: `emit('fncall.validate', { reason, action, route_id, sample_id: hash(payload) })`

nina: Sampling strategy: don't set sampling=0. Use low-rate (0.01) for soft rejects, 100% for strict rejects, and an on-demand backfill job that can pull associated payloads when route error-rate spikes. Backfill joins on `sample_id`.

ops-bot: deploy: validator v2.1 canary deployed at 1839990000. Health: yellow (errors in validation checks). See /deploys/1839990000

michael: For billing/quotas: decide whether soft-validated calls count toward billable tokens. My vote: bill only when downstream model runs. But we should emit `route.fallback_count{from_model,to_model}` so finance can reconcile.

sasha: Agreed. Also ensure quota attribution sticks to original request_id even if routed to degen. Add `route.request_id` tag everywhere.

kevin: I'll open a PR to: 1) add telemetry tags (validation_type, action, route_id, sample_id), 2) set default sampling for soft-rejects to 0.01, 3) implement coercion pass. PR in ~45m.

nina: I'll draft infra task for the backfill job (safe access to sanitized payload store + retention policy).

michael: I'll mock the 3-state toggle + sample preview UI. UX: show counts, example (sanitized), quick rollback button, and link to logs.

sasha: Let's pause strict rollout until telemetry + sampling + console soft-validate UI are in place. I'll update the rollout ticket and ping support to notify affected customers. :thumbsup:

kevin: One more: add `validator.sample_id` to logs so backfill can rehydrate examples without storing raw PII in metrics. Use a one-way hash with pepper.

nina: Add retention: sampled raw payloads kept 7d, sanitized snippets 30d. Ops can extend case-by-case.

sasha: Cool. Action items captured. Thanks everyone.
